subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin update and convergence use the installed target package version as the compatibility host for both upgrades and downgrades, and should the remaining unknown-host-version runtime report stay separate from this PR?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive compatibility source-of-truth decision, and the linked issue has grown beyond the exact stale current-process handoff that this PR fixes.

options.title: Accept target-version handoff
options.body: Land the PR after fresh current-base validation, and keep the unknown-host-version runtime report tracked separately if it remains reproducible.

options.title: Require scope split first
options.body: Ask the author or maintainer to remove closing linkage or create a follow-up before merge so the broader linked issue is not closed by this patch.

options.title: Hold for one broader fix
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the update handoff and runtime host-version detection issue solved in a single coordinated change.

recommendation.title: Accept target-version handoff
recommendation.body: Land the PR after fresh current-base validation, and keep the unknown-host-version runtime report tracked separately if it remains reproducible.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the update-command post-core plugin refresh boundary where this person has the clearest recent merged history.
